description: Land Title Settlement Department - Adukkana, Kurunegala D/S/Division Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No.420351 (24/0378)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land titles, property ownership determinations, and land parcel registrations.
